Hi, does the Harlow sofa come in green and can it get here before the 20th?
Yes! The Harlow comes in Moss Green. If you order today it can be delivered to your area on the 17th or 18th. Would you like me to hold one for you?Answered from: Product catalogue, Delivery times

Everything a support chatbot should do.

Mira only answers from your own content, so it doesn't make things up. When it isn't sure, it says so and passes the chat to a person.

Learns from your content

Add your website, PDFs, help centre or Google Docs. Mira reads them and stays updated when they change.

Smooth handover to people

Hard questions go to the right person in your team by email, Slack or your help desk, with the chat history attached.

Speaks 40 languages

Customers write in their own language and Mira replies in the same one, using your content.

Checks orders and bookings

Connect Shopify, WooCommerce or your booking tool so Mira can answer "where's my order?" with real details.

Reports you can act on

See the most common questions, where customers get stuck and which answers need better content.

Your brand, your tone

Choose the name, colours and tone of voice. Formal for a law firm, relaxed for a coffee shop.

Live on your website in three steps.

No developers needed. If you can copy and paste, you can set up Mira.

  1. Add your content

    Paste your website address and upload any documents. Mira reads them in a few minutes.

  2. Test and adjust

    Ask Mira questions in the preview window and correct any answer with one click.

  3. Paste one line of code

    Add the snippet to your site, or install the plugin for WordPress, Shopify, Wix or Webflow.

<!-- Paste before </body> -->
<script
  src="https://cdn.mira-chat.example/widget.js"
  data-bot="oakline-furniture"
  data-color="#2F6BFF"
  defer></script>

Works with the tools you already use.

WordPressShopifyWooCommerceWixWebflowSlackZendeskHubSpotGoogle DriveNotionWhatsAppZapier

Safe with your data.

Your data stays yoursWe never use your content to train public AI models.
GDPR readyData stored in the EU or US, your choice.
EncryptedAll data encrypted in transit and at rest.
Clear limitsMira only answers from content you approve.

Frequently asked questions

What is an AI chatbot for customer service?

An AI chatbot is a chat window on your website that reads your content and answers customer questions automatically, any time of day. Good chatbots pass difficult questions to someone on your team.

Will the chatbot make up wrong answers?

Mira only answers using content you've added. If it can't find the answer, it tells the customer and hands the chat to your team instead of guessing.

How long does it take to set up?

Most businesses have Mira live in 10 to 30 minutes. You add your website address, test a few questions and paste one line of code.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. You can install Mira with a plugin for WordPress, Shopify, Wix or Webflow, or by pasting one line of code.

What happens if I go over my conversation limit?

Mira keeps working. We'll email you and suggest the right plan, and you'll never be charged more without agreeing first.

Give your customers answers in seconds.

# Ai Chatbot

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/saas-landing/ai-chatbot/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
